senses.gloss:
चुञ्चु a.
—1 (At the end of certain comp.) Celebrated, famous, renowned, skilled
 in; तेन वित्तश्चुञ्चुप्चणपौ P. V. 2. 26. अक्षर˚, चार˚ &c. रामोऽपि
 मायाचणमस्त्रचुञ्चुः Bk. 2. 32.

चुञ्चु + .{@-ञ्चुः@} The musk-rat or shrew.
—2 A mixed caste born of a Brāhmaṇa father and Vaideha female; मेदान्ध्रचुञ्चुमद्गूनामारण्यपशुहिंसनम् Ms. 10. 48.
चुञ्चुरी A game played with tamarind seeds instead of dice.
